_comment: Hand-maintained John Herr's Village Market weekly deals. Maintained weekly via Claude Cowork — circular runs Thursday-Wednesday. Transcribe ~15 top deals from the weekly circular. Update validThrough to one day past the last valid day so deals auto-disappear when the new week starts (Thursday morning).
_format: dateRange: human-readable string shown in UI (e.g. 'Thursday, May 7 through Wednesday, May 13'). validThrough: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), exclusive end. deals: array of { item, salePrice, regularPrice (optional), savings (optional) }. salePrice can be flexible — '$2.99/lb', '2 for $5', 'BOGO Free', etc.
_source: Circular page typically at https://www.familyownedmarkets.com/print-weekly-specials/?circularstoreidentifier=54348 or via the store's main page.
